For me, the main draw of the A380 was that (at the time it launched) it was the best card you could get that did not need external power. This makes it great for use on a computer that you might want to do light gaming on but also use more than two monitors for non-gaming use. PCs with on-board graphics tend to only have two video outputs.

Yes you can go with a 1050Ti or even a 1650, but those only have 4GB of RAM for when you DO want to do a bit of gaming.

Now, there is the 3050 6GB that you can use instead, but it's $50-100 more for roughly the same capability.

Trying to build the perfect arcade computer and a ssf low power build that can run Tekken 8 is my goal but my best option is Windows or Arc.
